initializers: All four exact 20k natural-selector checkpoints, same tensor state within each arm pair; reset optimizer
mix_balance: Two contexts per cell per update, independent PCG permutation; semantic worlds/views/order/answers shared with familiar arm
no_confirmation_model_outputs_until: All eight terminal checkpoints complete and exact lock binds their hashes. No outcome-adaptive changes or checkpoint selection.
source_family_note: Current families0/1 are consulted development material. Family2 is frozen new wording and remains absent from engineering model runs and all training.

confirmation.controls: Original F0Q0 only: no_facts and cue_erased

exclusions.unit: Full ordered key/value history, four-view closure
exclusions.disjoint: Prior, engineering training, engineering evaluation, main training, confirmation; all accepted semantic worlds distinct

primary.metric: Both requested answers correct in original and order views (joint4)
primary.unit: World after averaging four paired checkpoint differences
primary.scope: Conditional on these initializers and exact training streams; no training-procedure variance estimate
primary.decision_rule: An endpoint is supported only if its adjusted interval lower bound is above zero; all three must pass for the broad three-shift claim. No nonsignificance-as-equivalence claim.

secondary: All other cells/groups, joint8, per-view BOTH, per-case endpoints, initial controls, erasure controls and familiar cost are descriptive.
acquisition_qualification: Existing 80% rule: >=205/256 development,>=103/128 training BOTH-correct in every normal cell/view and joint4 in every cell, per terminal; do not waive failures.

resources.stop: All eight or stop; no N/run reduction. Preserve failures. No automatic allocation renewal.

scope: Member C acquisition and reusable baseline qualification. Not native32, retention or final sleep/Hebbian efficacy. No publication/push/Google Doc edit.

acquisition_qualification_cells.additional: joint4 for each group/cell; joint8 descriptive
